SELECT
    a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    a.mattype AS material_type,
    u.displaydurmonths AS current_display_duration,
    u.displaydurmonths AS display_limit,
    (u.displaydurmonths - u.displaydurmonths) * (r.LER + 1) * (r.CPI + 1) / 100 AS calculated_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (u.displaydurmonths - u.displaydurmonths) * (r.LER + 1) * (r.CPI + 1) / 100 < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS recommendation
FROM
    artifactscore AS a
JOIN
    usagerecords AS u ON a.artregistry = u.artrefused
JOIN
    artifactratings AS r ON a.artregistry = r.artref
WHERE
    u.displayrotatesched = 'Active';
